DonationTraceById: Preferred one-call exact Donation trace. Returns Donation, Donor, residence Prefecture, recipient Municipality and Prefecture, selected Gift and Category, plus every registered Supplier at DonationId x SupplierId registration grain. DonationAmountYen repeats and is non-additive across Supplier rows.
AgentRawObservationTotals: Preferred one-row raw operational totals function over optional UTC EventMinute bucket bounds. WindowIsValid must be true before numeric values are used; false is invalid input, not a valid zero.
AgentObservationLeaders: Preferred deterministic operational Municipality leader function over optional UTC EventMinute bucket bounds. Select the requested LeaderMetric row, retain both raw metrics, require WindowIsValid=true, and preserve the raw duplicate caveat.
@RequestedDonationId: Exact bigint DonationId supplied as the sole function argument.
RequestedDonationId: Source-generated echo of the requested DonationId.
RowGrain: DonationId x SupplierId registration; DonationAmountYen is non-additive across rows.
StartUtc: Optional inclusive UTC lower bound applied to EventMinute minute-bucket keys.
EndUtc: Optional exclusive UTC upper bound applied to EventMinute minute-bucket keys.
RequestedStartUtc: Echo of the requested optional UTC lower bound.
RequestedEndUtc: Echo of the requested optional UTC upper bound.
WindowIsValid: Must be true before using numeric outputs; false denotes an invalid window, not a valid zero.
TrueFirstObservedAt: Earliest source FirstObservedAt among matching buckets; not the requested window bound.
TrueLastObservedAt: Latest source LastObservedAt among matching buckets; not the requested window bound.
RawObservationCount: Raw observation total from SUM(ObservationCount); possible duplicates, not unique events.
RawObservedAmountYen: Raw observed JPY total from SUM(ObservedAmountYen); possible duplicates, not a static Donation amount.
Scope: Operational query scope returned by the function.
SourceObject: Approved source object used by the function.
RawDuplicateCaveat: Possible duplicate raw observations; aggregate exposes no event identifier or unique metric.
TimeZoneNotice: UTC notice that must remain in Eventhouse results and final answers.
LeaderMetric: Metric whose deterministic winner this row represents.
LeaderValue: Returned value of LeaderMetric for this winner row.
MunicipalityID: Recipient Municipality string ID returned by Eventhouse; preserve leading zeros.
DonationAmountYen: Donation fact amount in JPY; repeated and non-additive across Supplier-registration rows.
DonorId: Stable ID of the Donor associated with the Donation.
DonorDisplayName: Donor display label returned by Lakehouse.
DonorResidencePrefectureId: Stable ID of the Donor residence Prefecture; not recipient geography.
DonorResidencePrefectureName: Name of the Donor residence Prefecture.
MunicipalityId: Stable ID of the recipient Municipality.
MunicipalityDisplayName: Display label of the recipient Municipality.
RecipientPrefectureId: Stable ID of the recipient Municipality's Prefecture.
RecipientPrefectureName: Name of the recipient Municipality's Prefecture.
GiftId: Stable ID of the Gift selected by the Donation.
GiftDisplayName: Display label of the selected Gift.
CategoryId: Stable ID of the selected Gift's Category.
CategoryName: Name of the selected Gift's Category.
SupplierId: Stable ID of one Supplier registered for the selected Gift.
SupplierName: Name of one registered Supplier returned by Lakehouse.
SupplierDisplayName: Display label of one registered Supplier returned by Lakehouse.
SourceSystem: Source system identifier returned by the selected function.
